t: A 32-bit chip with built-in USB that runs CircuitPython and Arduino code.
steps: Buy an Adafruit Feather M0 Express, QT Py SAMD21 or Seeed XIAO SAMD21 from a maker shop.
Get a USB cable that carries data and fits the board.
Double-tap the reset button. The board shows up as a USB drive.
Drag the CircuitPython file for your board onto that drive.
Install the free Mu editor on your computer.
Open the code.py file in Mu and paste the Blink example from the Adafruit guide.
Save the file. The light on the board starts to blink at once.
meta: Wild Open. From $5.40. Easy to find.
